About ParsFreight

The freight company behind the platform

Dock2Door is built and operated by ParsFreight, a Richmond, BC–based freight forwarder moving goods across Canada and around the world. We combined decades of hands-on logistics with modern software so shippers, warehouses and carriers can run everything — bookings, dispatch, labour and fulfillment — on one live network.

Full-service freight

Warehousing, drayage, trucking, customs and fulfillment coordinated by one team.

Cross-border reach

Vancouver and Toronto hubs moving freight across Canada, the US and overseas.

Licensed & bonded

A trusted freight forwarding partner with the compliance shippers rely on.

How it works

From dock to door in four moves.

No spreadsheets, no phone tag. Dock2Door turns the whole logistics workflow into a few taps — the same experience on web and mobile.

01

Find capacity

Search live warehouse space, drayage, trucking lanes and on-demand labour near your freight — with real pricing.

02

Book in seconds

Reserve space, dispatch a load or post a shift. Everything is quoted, contracted and confirmed in one flow.

03

Track it live

Follow every move end-to-end — dock appointments, shipments, POD and inventory — from a single console.

04

Settle automatically

Invoices, payouts and billing reconcile themselves, so money moves as smoothly as your freight.

Live global network

Your freight, moving on a living map.

Watch shipments travel between hubs in real time. Dock2Door connects every node of the supply chain into one continuously updating network.

Global reach

One network spanning 48 countries and every major port, lane and hub.

Smart routing

Freight is matched to the fastest, cheapest lane in real time.

Live telemetry

Every container, truck and shift streams status to one console.

One connected network

Every side of the supply chain, on one platform.

Warehousing, drayage, trucking, fulfillment and on-demand labour all talk to each other in real time — a live view of the same modules you get in the mobile app.

Everything the app does

One console for every operator.

Whatever your role in the supply chain, you get the exact same tools on the web that you have in the mobile app — nothing left behind.

Warehousing & WMS

Book on-demand storage, manage listings, staff, stations and payouts with a full warehouse management overview.

Fulfillment

Orders, shipments, manifests, returns and rate-shopping — a complete 3PL fulfillment engine.

Trucking & dispatch

A live job board, fleet, dispatch, dock appointments, POD review and finance for carriers and drivers.

Drayage

Move containers from port to door with on-time drayage matched to your lanes and appointments.

On-demand labour

Post shifts, browse certified workers, track hours & attendance, and settle billing automatically.

Services marketplace

Find and book specialist logistics services, or list your own and win new jobs across the network.
